name: ROUND THE WORLD POKER
description: Round the World Poker is a poker variant in which the required hand to win changes each deal: the first deal is won by high card, the second by pair, then two pair, three of a kind, and so on up through royal flush. Each deal is played like five-card draw with betting; only the hand type that wins the pot changes round by round.

content.text: Round the World Poker is a poker variant in which the required hand to win changes each deal: the first deal is won by high card, the second by pair, then two pair, three of a kind, and so on up through royal flush. Each deal is played like five-card draw with betting; only the hand type that wins the pot changes round by round.

Round the World is a home-game poker variant in which the winning hand type rotates each deal, from high card through royal flush. It is commonly played as part of Dealer's Choice and is documented in poker variant collections.
Two to eight players; best with about six.

Each deal: five cards face down to each player. The required hand to win that deal is determined by the round number (e.g. round 1 high card, round 2 pair, up to royal flush), then play follows standard five-card draw with a betting round, draw, and final betting round before showdown.

items.text: Short cycle: Use fewer hand types per cycle (e.g. high card, pair, two pair, three of a kind, straight) then repeat.
